About Skyflex
Louvred pergola questions Melbourne buyers ask
lede_pattern: Skyflex makes pergolas Melbourne homeowners and businesses use all year, turning a backyard, patio or courtyard into a room that works in every season.
Melbourne can hand you four seasons before lunch, so a pergola here has to do more than throw shade on a still summer day.
Ours open to the sun when it is out and close against the rain when it is not, which is what keeps the space underneath in use rather than sitting empty for half the year.

We are based in Epping, with a showroom where you can stand under the full Delta range before you buy, and every pergola is sold either as a [DIY kit](https://skyflex.au/pergola-kits/) or fitted by one of our approved installers at an affordable rate.
Order the same product either way.
homepage.closing_pattern: **How do I order, and can I see one first?** Order online, or request a quote for a custom project and the team will match it to the right model and finish. You are also welcome to visit the Epping showroom by appointment to see the range before you buy.

Who a Skyflex pergola in Sydney suits
About Skyflex
Pergola questions from Sydney buyers
lede_pattern: Skyflex supplies pergolas Sydney homeowners and businesses order as a [kit](https://skyflex.au/pergola-kits/), shipped to your address and fitted through a network of approved installers.
We are a manufacturer based in Melbourne that ships nationwide, so a Sydney order works a little differently to booking a local builder.
You choose the size, colour and configuration, we make and ship the pergola, and you either assemble it with the supplied instructions or have an approved installer fit it.
There is no in-house Skyflex crew in Sydney.
Supplying it this way, rather than as a bespoke on-site build, is a large part of why the finished pergola lands well under a custom-built one.
louvred-pergolas-sydney.closing_pattern: **How do I get a price for my space?** Request a quote through the site with your size and configuration, and the Skyflex team will come back with the kit price, the colour and the approved-installer option in one go.
